prior_stories.headline: Oil tops $100 amid U.S.-Iran fighting
prior_stories.body:
Global benchmark oil prices climbed above $100 a barrel as fighting involving the United States and Iran threatened energy production and shipping.

U.S. gasoline prices continued to rise, while stocks fell.

candidates.title: Census Bureau proposes major changes for the 2030 count
candidates.summary: The Census Bureau proposed excluding undocumented immigrants and some other foreign nationals from the population used to apportion House seats. The proposal would also prohibit race, ethnicity and sexual-orientation questions on the decennial enumeration questionnaire while permitting demographic data to be obtained from other sources.

candidates.title: Appeals court keeps block on federal mail-voting restrictions
candidates.summary: A federal appeals court declined to pause an injunction against new Postal Service requirements for election mail. The rules would require states to obtain advance approval of ballot-envelope designs and submit voter information through a federal portal.

sources.name: U.S. Court of Appeals filing hosted by the Supreme Court

candidates.title: Appeals court rejects mandatory detention without bond hearings for immigrants
candidates.summary: A divided federal appeals court ruled that the Trump administration's policy of detaining certain immigrants without an opportunity to seek release on bond was illegal.

candidates.title: Supreme Court intervenes again in Missouri congressional-map dispute
candidates.summary: The Supreme Court stayed a federal district court order in litigation over Missouri's Trump-backed congressional map. State officials were consequently poised to use the districts adopted after the 2020 census for the November election while litigation continued.

sources.name: Supreme Court of the United States

candidates.title: Administration announces $500 refunds for some Affordable Care Act enrollees
candidates.summary: The White House said nearly one million people who bought unsubsidized coverage through the federal Affordable Care Act marketplace in 30 states would receive $500 refund checks beginning in October, drawing on surplus marketplace user fees.

candidates.title: Treasury sanctions networks accused of supporting Hezbollah groups
candidates.summary: The Treasury Department imposed sanctions on entities and individuals it said supported Lebanese Hezbollah and Iraq's Kata'ib Hezbollah. It also shifted most Iran-related applications for specific sanctions licenses to a presumption of denial, with limited exceptions.

candidates.title: Bank regulators expand 18-month examination cycle
candidates.summary: Federal bank regulators raised the asset threshold for qualifying institutions to receive on-site examinations every 18 months instead of annually from $3 billion to $6 billion. The OCC estimated that about 50 additional institutions under its supervision would qualify.

sources.name: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

candidates.title: Houthis seize strategic Yemeni port near Red Sea shipping route
candidates.summary: Iran-backed Houthi forces captured the port city of Mokha during a rapid offensive against forces aligned with Yemen's internationally recognized government. The city is near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a major route connecting the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden.

candidates.title: Canada and Ukraine sign 100-year partnership declaration
candidates.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy signed a declaration intended to elevate relations into a comprehensive strategic partnership. Canada also announced initiatives covering drone production, air defense, humanitarian assistance and loan guarantees for Ukrainian energy security.

candidates.title: Hawaii begins restoring services after Hurricane Lowell
candidates.summary: Crews began repairing the sole cargo port serving one of Hawaii's smallest main islands, while utilities worked to restore power elsewhere after Hurricane Lowell passed along the state's western side. The damaged port is the island's principal route for food and fuel shipments.

candidates.title: 49ers win NFL's first regular-season game in Australia
candidates.summary: The San Francisco 49ers defeated the Los Angeles Rams 27-7 at the Melbourne Cricket Ground in the first NFL regular-season game played in Australia. The game occurred on September 10 in U.S. Eastern time and September 11 in Melbourne.

candidates.title: Federal prosecutors open criminal inquiry into Clippers dealings
candidates.summary: Federal prosecutors in Brooklyn opened an early-stage criminal investigation into allegations that the Los Angeles Clippers helped arrange outside sponsorship contracts for Kawhi Leonard to circumvent the NBA salary cap. Reporting said at least one subpoena had been issued, while the inquiry's targets and possible offenses remained unclear.

candidates.title: State Department launches international commercial-space partnership
candidates.summary: The State Department launched the Space Catalyst Partnership in Lima, Peru, to promote civil and commercial space cooperation between the United States and other Artemis Accords signatories, including assistance connecting partner countries with U.S. technology, companies and government financing.

sources.name: U.S. Department of State via Public Technologies

candidates.title: Proposed $125 million settlement advances Passaic River cleanup
candidates.summary: The Justice Department and Environmental Protection Agency lodged a proposed settlement requiring Environmental Resource Holdings to perform an estimated $125 million in work supporting cleanup of the Diamond Alkali Superfund site and the lower 17 miles of New Jersey's Passaic River.

candidates.title: Oracle reports accelerating AI-cloud demand
candidates.summary: Oracle reported quarterly results above Wall Street estimates, a sharp increase in its contracted revenue backlog and a smaller-than-expected cash burn as demand grew for cloud infrastructure used in artificial intelligence. The company modestly raised its fiscal-year earnings forecast.

stories.headline: Court rejects detention without bond hearings
stories.body:
A divided federal appeals court ruled that the Trump administration may not detain certain immigrants without letting them seek release at a bond hearing.

The ruling addresses access to a hearing, not whether an individual must be released.

stories.headline: Supreme Court allows Missouri map for November
stories.body:
The Supreme Court stayed a lower-court order in the challenge to Missouri's Trump-backed congressional map. State officials were consequently poised to use the districts adopted after the 2020 census in November.

The stay applies while litigation continues and does not resolve the underlying challenge.

sources.name: Supreme Court of the United States

stories.headline: Houthis capture strategic Yemeni port
stories.body:
Iran-backed Houthi forces captured Mokha, a Yemeni port city near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, in a rapid offensive against forces aligned with Yemen's internationally recognized government.

The strait connects the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden and is a major shipping route. The reports did not establish an immediate disruption to traffic.
